data.text:
We're sorry for the rate limits and unnecessary quota consumption on the K3.1 Pro subscription plan. These were our issues, and we should have fixed them sooner.

Today, every subscriber on every plan gets a one-time usage reset, restoring 25% of their monthly quota (usage below 25% resets to zero), equal to one week of usage. Your usage bar will reflect this adjustment by end of day PST.

We've also adjusted the plan's parameters and are reducing unnecessary subagent calls and output length, so your quota goes further.

Thank you for your patience while we put this right.

Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro: our most capable 3T-class open-weight model.

🔹 1M-token context, 2.8T total / 104B active params (MoE), Multimodal.
🔹 Full-project coding: games in Unreal, Unity & Godot.
🔹 Excels at parametric 3D modeling in Blender & CAD.
🔹 More reliable at finance work: Accurate modeling with hallucination down by 65%.
🔹 Matching the strongest proprietary models across coding, agentic and knowledge benchmarks.

Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed (2–3× faster) are now live on https://t.co/85jA71X9gw, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API.  

Open weights by Nov 4, 2026.

🔗 API: https://t.co/XCrgjXAqMw 
🔗 Tech blog: https://t.co/5iPP0MBej6
